title: Global preservation
text: random_pair_distance_correlation() measures Pearson correlation matched input output distances default. Set method = "spearman" compare ranks. Euclidean squared Euclidean ordering, Spearman interpretation equivalent. Squaring changes magnitudes can change default Pearson result.

title: Global preservation
text: random_pair_distance_emd() compares empirical input output distance distributions using Earth Mover’s Distance (1D Wasserstein). EMD compares marginal distributions rather pairwise correspondence. EMD stress magnitude statistics. Squared Euclidean can change results relative Euclidean distance, even sampled distance vector range-scaled.

title: Global preservation
text: random_pair_distance_stress() compares matched sampled distances root mean squared difference, scaling distance vector [0, 1] default.

title: Global preservation
text: rnx_auc() summarizes exact rank-based neighborhood agreement across neighborhood sizes, giving weight smaller neighborhoods. Use rnx_curve() inspect individual neighborhood sizes. default returns complete curve; pass k select particular scales. curve diagnoses scale-specific preservation; establish universally preferred embedding. RNX AUC 1 perfect, 0 random-neighborhood baseline, negative values indicate worse--random rank agreement.
code: iris_x <- as.matrix(iris[, -5]) pca_iris <- stats::prcomp(iris_x, retx = TRUE, rank. = 2)$x din <- as.matrix(stats::dist(iris_x)) dout <- as.matrix(stats::dist(pca_iris)) rnx_auc(din, dout) rnx_curve(din, dout, k = c(5, 15, 30))

title: Local preservation
text: local preservation use nearest neighbor preservation. Pass vector k get back preservation different numbers neighbors. Supplied graphs use one-based indices nearest-first order. Quadra checks columns, removes self-indices, retains first k non-self neighbors, self-inclusive graphs need least k + 1 columns. Supplied order resolves ties; nbr_pres() includes boundary ties, exact rank metrics break ties distance-matrix column order. Graph searches pass supported sparse inputs rnndescent; nonnumeric data-frame columns ignored. Exact Euclidean squared-Euclidean searches ordering, subject ties approximation.
code: iris_x <- as.matrix(iris[, -5]) pca_iris <- stats::prcomp(iris_x, retx = TRUE, rank. = 2)$x nn_preservation(iris_x, pca_iris, k = c(15, 30))

title: Local preservation
text: trustworthiness() continuity() exact rank-penalty neighborhood metrics distance matrices. Trustworthiness penalizes observations appear low-dimensional neighbors even though close input space. Continuity applies dual penalty input-space neighbors longer nearby embedding. functions use full n n distance matrices require k less half number observations, intended exact small-dataset checks. larger datasets, use nearest-neighbor preservation metrics nn_preservation() nbr_pres_knn().
code: din <- as.matrix(stats::dist(iris_x)) dout <- as.matrix(stats::dist(pca_iris)) trustworthiness(din, dout, k = c(5, 15, 30)) continuity(din, dout, k = c(5, 15, 30))

title: Local preservation
text: Nearest neighbor preservation asks whether observations remain nearby. local_radius_correlation() asks different local-scale question: points dense sparse regions input data still relatively small large nearest-neighbor radii embedding? default, metric uses Spearman correlation distance kth nearest non-self neighbor input data output embedding. Set statistic = "mean" use mean distance first k neighbors, log = TRUE compare log radii selected radii positive. Local radius uses distance magnitudes, squared Euclidean can differ Euclidean. already nearest-neighbor graphs distance matrices, can reuse : metric radius scale diagnostic. estimate local density directly interpreted alongside neighbor-identity metrics nn_preservation().
code: local_radius_correlation(   iris_x,   pca_iris,   k = c(15, 30),   nn_method_in = "brute" ) cached <- local_radius_correlation(   iris_x,   pca_iris,   k = c(15, 30),   nn_method_in = "brute",   ret_extra = TRUE )  local_radius_correlation(cached$nn_in, cached$nn_out, k = c(15, 30))

title: Local preservation
text: mutual_neighbor_correlation() compares mutual-neighbor count patterns. observation, mutual-neighbor count number first k nearest neighbors also include observation among first k nearest neighbors. graph diagnostic. require neighbor distances, cached idx-nearest-neighbor graphs enough. interpreted alongside neighbor-identity metrics nn_preservation() scale metrics local_radius_correlation(). larger datasets, nn_preservation() can use approximate nearest neighbors via rnndescent. nearest-neighbor matrices another approximate nearest neighbor package, e.g. RcppAnnoy, use nbr_pres_knn function:
code: mutual_neighbor_correlation(   iris_x,   pca_iris,   k = c(15, 30),   nn_method_in = "brute" ) # A function to wrap the RcppAnnoy API to return a matrix of the nearest # neighbor indices find_nn <- function(   X,   k = 10,   n_trees = 50,   search_k = (k + 1) * n_trees ) {   nr <- nrow(X)   nc <- ncol(X)   requested_k <- k + 1    ann <- methods::new(RcppAnnoy::AnnoyEuclidean, nc)   for (i in seq_len(nr)) {     ann$addItem(i - 1, X[i, ])   }   ann$build(n_trees)    idx <- matrix(nrow = nr, ncol = k)   for (i in seq_len(nr)) {     res <- ann$getNNsByItemList(i - 1, requested_k, search_k, FALSE)     non_self <- res$item[res$item != i - 1]     if (length(non_self) < k) {       stop(         "search_k/n_trees settings were unable to find ",         k,         " non-self neighbors for item ",         i       )     }     idx[i, ] <- non_self[seq_len(k)]   }   idx + 1 }  kin <- find_nn(as.matrix(iris[, -5]), k = 5) kout <- find_nn(pca_iris, k = 5)  # This should give very similar results to using nbr_pres on the distance # matrices, subject to the approximations employed by Annoy nbr_pres_knn(kin, kout, k = 5)

title: quadra 0.2.1
text: Random-pair distance metrics random_triplet_accuracy() now accept reusable samples sample_pairs() sample_triplets(). ret_extra = TRUE, return sampled comparisons pair distances triplet agreement outcomes. New rnx_curve() returns exact rank agreement neighborhood size. trustworthiness() continuity() now accept multiple k values. roc_auc() pr_auc() now accept ret_extra = TRUE return row-aligned query AUCs number defined queries.

title: quadra 0.2.1
text: nbr_pres(), trustworthiness(), continuity(), rnx_auc() now reject nonfinite -diagonal distances; diagonal values remain ignored.

title: quadra 0.2.0
text: New metric: trustworthiness() continuity() exact distance-matrix rank-penalty neighborhood preservation fixed k. useful small datasets, though needs full distance matrix. New metric: local_radius_correlation() comparing local radius scale preservation raw observations nearest-neighbor graphs distances. Possibly useful dimensionality reduction methods attempt retain density input data (standard t-SNE UMAP ). Added Spearman rank-correlation support random_pair_distance_correlation() via method = "spearman". New metric: random_pair_distance_stress() sampled root mean squared differences matched random-pair distances. like traditional STRESS metric (basically root mean square error input output distances), sampling subset distances, can scale larger datasets. New metric: mutual_neighbor_correlation() comparing mutual-neighbor count patterns input output nearest-neighbor graphs. random_triplet_accuracy(), rnx_auc(), nn_preservation() nbr_pres_knn() now implemented C++ faster calculate.

title: quadra 0.2.0
text: Substantially improved input validation across package. Corrected self-neighbor handling nbr_pres_knn() supplied nearest-neighbor graphs. roc_auc() pr_auc() now handle retrieval problems undefined rows consistently. nbr_pres_knn() now supports multithreaded calculations n_threads. rnndescent now CRAN, longer need install github. grain_size thread-handling removed API exposed . Numeric random_triplet_accuracy() sampling uses new sampler, exact sample sequence can differ earlier versions. Set seed thread count reproducible results within version. Matrix triplet inputs unchanged. Fix issue index-nearest neighbor graphs allowed metrics didn’t need distances. nn_preservation() now excludes “self”-neighbor (.e. item ) nearest-neighbor graphs. calculating graph internally, k + 1 extra neighbors requested rnndescent.

title: quadra 0.1.0 (November 20 2023)
text: New function: random_triplet_accuracy, used PaCMAP paper evaluating global preservation. New function: nn_preservation nearest neighbor preservation function can use approximate nearest neighbors multiple threads faster calculations. also supports metrics Euclidean. New function: random_pair_distance_correlation evaluating global preservation, similar method used Becht co-workers. New function: random_pair_distance_emd evaluating global preservation, similar method Heiser Lau. Changed license GPL3+. Building package now requires compiling C++. package also now non-CRAN dependency: rnndescent, github.
